294    public function syncUserLookup(): void
295    {
296        if (! $this->canSyncUserLookup()) {
297            return;
298        }
299
300        DB::table($this->userLookupTable())
301            ->where('employee_id', $this->id)
302            ->where('company_id', $this->company_id)
303            ->where('email', '!=', $this->email)
304            ->delete();
305
306        // Defense in depth: Never overwrite a lookup record belonging to a different employee.
307        // This prevents cross-tenant hijacking if validation is somehow bypassed.
308        $existing = DB::table($this->userLookupTable())
309            ->where('email', $this->email)
310            ->first();
311
312        if ($existing && (int) $existing->employee_id !== (int) $this->id) {
313            return;
314        }
315
316        DB::table($this->userLookupTable())->updateOrInsert(
317            ['email' => $this->email],
318            [
319                'company_id' => $this->company_id,
320                'schema_name' => $this->company?->schema_name ?? 'shared_tenants',
321                'employee_id' => $this->id,
322                'role' => $this->userLookupRole(),
323            ]
324        );
325    }
326
327    public function deleteUserLookup(): void
328    {
329        if (! $this->canSyncUserLookup()) {
330            return;
331        }
332
333        DB::table($this->userLookupTable())
334            ->where('employee_id', $this->id)
335            ->where('company_id', $this->company_id)
336            ->delete();
337    }
338
339    private function canSyncUserLookup(): bool
340    {
341        if (! $this->email || ! $this->company_id) {
342            return false;
343        }
344
345        if (DB::getDriverName() !== 'pgsql') {
346            return Schema::hasTable('user_lookups');
347        }
348
349        $table = DB::selectOne("select to_regclass('public.user_lookups') as table_name");
350
351        return $table?->table_name !== null;
352    }
353
354    private function userLookupTable(): string
355    {
356        return DB::getDriverName() === 'pgsql' ? 'public.user_lookups' : 'user_lookups';
357    }
358
359    private function userLookupRole(): string
360    {
361        $role = $this->getAttribute('role');
362
363        return is_string($role) && $role !== ''
364            ? $role
365            : 'employee';
366    }
